title: Player composition facade
scenario: The game service drives the player through one facade that binds the lives counter, the ship state machine, and the weapon. The facade turns service events such as being hit into outcomes and hides the delegation details.
instructions: In src/domain/player.rs define Player with new(lives, screen), lives, ship, update(dt, screen), hit returning whether the session is over, rotate, accelerate, and fire returning an optional bullet.

hints.body: Player::new spawns the ship Invulnerable with ShipState::INVULNERABILITY_TIME; hit() matches on the ship state.
hit() returns false unless the ship is Active; then lose_one drives the result: Remaining starts a respawn, GameOver returns true. fire() needs a ship and a ready weapon.
The reference approach for this lesson.

completionExplanation: Your code matches the reference approach: the previous lesson's work stays active, and the new types compile against the public tests.
